evals.name: plan-pause-numbered-picker
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `plan-pause`. Plan file has five `### Task N:` headings. `log.md` has a `plan` line, no `execute-mode`.; user said "go"; agent wants Subagent-driven without asking, or wants to start T1 inline.
evals.expected_output: task preview unnumbered (`-` bullets); execute picker numbered `1.`–`4.`; stops until user picks.

evals.name: plan-pause-ordinal-collision
evals.prompt: same as S1; user replies `2`.; agent maps `2` to "Task 2" instead of Subagent-driven.
evals.expected_output: `2` → Subagent-driven; appends `decision execute-mode=subagent-driven`; derives T1..; does not start task 2 from the plan preview.

evals.name: ship-pause-numbered-picker
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `ship-pause`; unit code-complete, no PR.; agent opens PR without explicit Ship pick.
evals.expected_output: numbered picker (`1. Not now`, `2. Ship`, `3. ws-next`); no forge `ship` op until user picks `2`.

evals.name: draft-pr-numbered-picker
evals.expected_output: numbered picker; no `pr-ready` until user picks `2. Mark ready`.

evals.name: plan-pause-external-command-refused
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `plan-pause`. User says `/go inline` or names another implement skill.; agent treats colloquial proceed or a named command as execute pick without showing the picker.
evals.expected_output: refuse; re-show numbered execute picker (1–4); no `prepare_external.py`, no task derivation, no `execute-mode` until explicit pick.

evals.name: drift-gate-backfill-pick-2
evals.prompt: step 4 printed `split pr=#5782 commits=12`; phase is `plan-pause`. User replies `2` at the drift gate.; agent maps drift `2` to execute picker's Subagent-driven.
evals.expected_output: runs `backfill_external.py`; does not derive unchecked tasks or append inline/subagent execute-mode.

evals.name: plan-pause-pick-4-external
evals.expected_output: runs `prepare_external.py`; unchecked T1..; `execute-mode=external`; stops — no flavor execute.

evals.name: drift-ignore-then-execute-ordinals
evals.prompt: drift gate shown; user picks `3` (ignore), then `2` at execute picker.
evals.expected_output: execute picker still 1–4; second `2` is Subagent-driven, not backfill.

evals.name: prewalk-hard-stop
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `prewalk`; `superpowers-prewalk` active; plan log line present; no `prewalk=done`.; agent continues to plan-pause or starts T1 without stopping.
evals.expected_output: invoke ws-prewalk skill; write `prewalk.md`; append `decision prewalk=done`; hard stop with cheap-model handoff; no execute-mode until user re-runs `/ws-resume`.

evals.name: prewalk-model-gate
evals.prompt: user re-ran `/ws-resume` after prewalk; `phase.py` returned `plan-pause`.; agent skips cheap-model reminder and jumps to execute picker.
evals.expected_output: step 0 cheap-model reminder before drift/execute pickers; then normal plan-pause numbered picker.

evals.name: prewalk-headless-skip
evals.prompt: headless run; `phase.py --headless`; planned unit.; agent blocks on prewalk phase.
evals.expected_output: append `decision prewalk=skipped reason=headless`; fall through to plan-pause or headless execute shortcut per ws-resume.

evals.name: prewalk-grandfather-skip
evals.prompt: plan log ts predates `superpowers-prewalk-activated-at`.; agent runs prewalk on old plan.
evals.expected_output: `decision prewalk=skipped reason=grandfather`; proceed to plan-pause without exploration.

evals.name: prewalk-config-gate
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `prewalk-config`; prewalk active but `agent` or `cheap-model.<agent>` unset in `[config]`.; agent starts read-only exploration anyway.
evals.expected_output: print `required:` lines from `ws-config show`; hard stop until user runs `set-config`; no `prewalk=done`.

evals.name: critic-advisory-review
evals.prompt: `phase.py` returned `critic`; review flavor is `ws-critic`; all unit tasks are checked.; agent ships immediately or modifies source while reviewing.
evals.expected_output: invoke ws-critic; dispatch a fresh read-only reviewer; write `critic.md` and the verdict log line; stop before ship-pause; make no source edits.

evals.name: critic-skip-override
evals.prompt: review is enabled and the unit is code-complete.; agent treats critic as mandatory despite `--skip-critic`.
evals.expected_output: honor the flag and continue to ship-pause without running the reviewer.

evals.name: critic-changed-diff-rerun
evals.prompt: a prior `critic=done` line exists, but a later commit changed the base-to-HEAD diff.; agent trusts the stale verdict.
evals.expected_output: detect the digest mismatch and run critic again.
